poses.name: stance
poses.note: His stance (move 1's header pose), in small entries.

poses.name: crouch
poses.note: His crouch (move 5, stream 0x0d660), his fists up before his face.

poses.name: crouching_hit
poses.note: His ROM reactions have no crouching hit (his hit table's crouching entries play standing poses). The hunched upper body of his hit reaction (0x160c, streams 0x0597e-0x05f98), head jerked down and arms drawn in, down to his chest, laid on his crouch and joined there; only the band where they meet is inpainted. The first two rounds joined them at the belt (the maintainer, 2026-11-06); the third was approved.

poses.name: hook_windup
poses.note: His lunging hook's wind-up (stream 0x0db1c, x-offset 8): knees bent, leaning in, fists drawn in at his chest.

poses.name: overhand_windup
poses.note: His lunging hook's follow-through (stream 0x0db1c), his back to us and his striking arm cocked high over his head: the overhand's wind-up.

poses.name: duck_windup
poses.note: His ducking punch's wind-up (stream 0x0da26): low on his knees, leaning forward, his fist drawn back at his hip.

poses.name: straight_windup
poses.note: His straight's step-in (stream 0x0d956, 8 pixels forward): leaning in, both fists pulled in at his chest.

poses.name: straight
poses.note: His straight's strike (stream 0x0d956, 32 pixels forward and 16 up, as the stream places it), his back to us and his arm driven straight out at head height. The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated body hooks and overhand rights were rejected, it stands in for both, and as the throw's shove.

poses.name: duck_punch
poses.note: His ducking punch's strike (stream 0x0da26, x-offset 32), lunging low with his arm driven forward. The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated low body hooks and crouching uppercuts were rejected, it stands in for both.

poses.name: grabbed
poses.note: His being-thrown set, seized: the first pose of his standing-hit reaction (stream 0x05914), his fists before his face.

poses.name: thrown_1
poses.note: His being-thrown set, lifted: his knocked-back pose (0x1650, streams 0x05a92-0x06176) turned a quarter clockwise, head first, off the ground.

poses.name: thrown_2
poses.note: His being-thrown set, over the top: the same pose turned upside down, higher still.

poses.name: lying
poses.note: The pose every knock-out stream of his ends on (streams 0x061a0-0x06590), centred on him so the get-up rises where he lies.

poses.name: rising
poses.note: Getting up off the floor: his ducking punch's wind-up (0x15aa) with everything below his head inpainted, kneeling, his near hand pressed flat on the floor, pushing himself up. His head is the ROM pose's, pixel for pixel. The first round, his jump's tuck set on the ground, did not read as getting up (the maintainer, 2026-11-06).

poses.name: jump_top
poses.note: The top of every jump of his (streams 0x0d2d2, 0x0d506, 0x0d6d4): tucked, his knees drawn up and his fists before his face. Shown 48 pixels up, a suggested height mid-jump; SF1+ moves him through his ROM arcs. His jumping attacks start and end on it.

poses.name: jump_punch
poses.note: Pieced from his own ROM pixels: his jab's upper body (0x1470, rows 9-53), his front arm driven straight out at shoulder height and his rear fist at his chin, on the trousers, crotch and shoes of his top-of-jump tuck (0x1608), untouched. The torso is set so its sides run straight down into the trousers' top (its left side over the seat's outer edge, its belt line just above the waistband); only his shirt's hem, belt and buckle and the waistband between them are inpainted. Round one inpainted the top of the jeans and changed the crotch; round two left the torso 7 pixels right of the trousers, a step at the waist (the maintainer, 2026-11-07).

poses.name: jump_punch_down
poses.note: Generated whole on his straight's turned upper body laid on his tuck (the pose base, at his scale) and his straight (0x14e0) for the arm, posed as Ryu's jumping punch (0x03e5): his back half turned, his rear arm driven down and forward from the shoulder, the fist at his knees, his knees tucked. His ROM head (his straight's turned head) is laid back over the generated one. Lined up with the jump punch by his head.

poses.name: jump_jab_down
poses.note: Generated whole on the jump punch's rebuilt pose (at his scale) and his jab (0x1470) for the arm: facing us, leaning forward, his front arm jabbed down and forward from the shoulder, his rear fist at his chin, his knees tucked. His ROM head (his jab's) is laid back over the generated one. Lined up with the jump punch by his head.

poses.name: jump_hook
poses.note: Pieced from his own ROM pixels: his lunging hook's strike (0x1560, rows 13-55), his back turned and his hooking arm swung round at head height, on the trousers, crotch and shoes of his top-of-jump tuck (0x1608), untouched, so his legs face the player. The torso is set so its sides run straight down into the trousers' top; only his shirt's hem, belt and the waistband between them are inpainted. Round one inpainted the top of the jeans, so the trousers looked turned away; round two left the torso 7 pixels right of the trousers, a step at the waist (the maintainer, 2026-11-07).

poses.name: jump_hammer
poses.note: Generated whole on the jump punch's rebuilt pose and his jab (0x1470) for the arms: leaning forward, both arms swung down and forward from the shoulders, his taped fists together before his knees, his knees tucked. His ROM head (his jab's) is laid back over the generated one. Lined up with the jump punch by his head.

poses.name: iron_peak
poses.note: The Iron Upper's peak, carrying on from his hook's follow-through (0x14e7): its turned back, rear arm and his ROM turned head, pixel for pixel, with the striking arm on the opponent's side inpainted from the shoulder, driven straight up, the fist above his head, and his legs below the belt inpainted hanging off the ground, heels up. The inpainted jeans' off-palette blues are taken to his jeans pens and his ROM sneakers (from his take-off step, 0x1406) are laid on the cuffs. Shown 16 pixels up. The first round, his win pose's raised fist on the step's legs, faced the player and read as a victory pose (the maintainer, 2026-11-07).

moves.name: crouching block
moves.note: His ROM crouch, both fists up before his face, held as the block, as Sagat's and Joe's are. The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated crouching blocks (his standing guard joined to the crouch three ways, then the crouch with raised forearms) were rejected.

moves.name: crouching hit
moves.note: One pose, as Ryu's crouching hit is, for the crouching entries of his hit table.

moves.name: body hook
moves.note: His MK (AP2's left hook to the body). The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated hooks were rejected, it is his ROM straight (stream 0x0d956): step-in, strike, step-in, then his stance. His LK, a short body jab (AP2), is his ROM jab stream (0x0d8c6).

moves.name: overhand right
moves.note: His HK (AP2's overhand right): his arm cocked over his head (his hook's follow-through), then his ROM straight's strike, back through his hook's wind-up to his stance. The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated overhands were rejected.

moves.name: low body hook
moves.note: His crouching MK (AP2's low body hook). The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated low hooks were rejected, it is his ROM ducking punch (stream 0x0da26). His crouching LK, a low jab (AP2), is that stream too.

moves.name: crouching uppercut
moves.note: His crouching HK (AP2's crouching uppercut). The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated uppercuts were rejected, it is his ROM ducking punch (stream 0x0da26), as his low body hook is.

moves.name: throw
moves.note: The clinch headbutt (AP2), cut to a grab and a shove from his ROM poses: his hook's wind-up, leaning in with his fists at his chest, as the grab, and his straight's strike as the shove; then his stance. No headbutt pose. The maintainer's decision at the review limit (2026-11-06): after four rounds of generated clinches and headbutts were rejected. The opponent plays his being-thrown set mirrored, as a throw that shoves the victim away does.

moves.name: thrown
moves.note: His generic being-thrown set, used by every throw: seized, lifted head first, over the top, landing on the floor. All from his own ROM poses, as Ryu's is. SF1+ moves him through the arc and turns him round on landing; then the get-up.

moves.name: get-up
moves.note: From lying he pushes himself up onto a knee, comes up into his crouch and rises into his stance.

moves.name: jumping punch
moves.note: His jumping punch buttons (as Ryu's straight-up jumping punch): a straight jab out at head height. His jumps stay his ROM streams; the attacks start and end on the top-of-jump tuck.

moves.name: jumping diagonal punch
moves.note: His punch buttons on a diagonal jump (as Ryu's diagonal jumping punch): a straight driven down and forward.

moves.name: jumping low jab
moves.note: His jumping LK (AP2's downward jab): his lead hand jabbed down and forward.

moves.name: jumping hook
moves.note: His jumping MK (AP2's jumping hook): his ROM hook, swung round at head height in the air.

moves.name: jumping hammer
moves.note: His jumping HK (AP2's two-fisted hammer): from the tuck, both fists clubbed down together before his knees.

moves.name: bison rush
moves.note: The Bison Rush (AP2), free from his ROM poses: he drops into a low boxer's crouch (his ducking wind-up, fist drawn back), charges in (his hook's wind-up, knees bent, leaning in) and finishes with a full-extension right straight (his straight's strike), back through its step-in to his stance. SF1+ carries him forward through the charge.

moves.name: iron upper
moves.note: The Iron Upper (AP2): he crouches, fist drawn back low (his ducking wind-up), drives up into the rising uppercut (his hook's follow-through, 0x14e7: his back turned, the striking arm bent and driving up on the opponent's side, the fist above his head) and on into the peak, the same turned body with the arm driven straight up and both feet off the ground, and lands in his crouch. A generated rising pose came out about 90% of his size and was not used.
